m4_supersede._replaces: M4 (original: 'no YC names/logos in video; categorical satire only')
new_rules: No company logos anywhere (site or video). Text names only, in our own typography.
Company descriptions: public-source citations only (e.g. quoted from public job posting).
Site + video footer disclaimer: 'WhyC is independent research. Inclusion is not endorsement by any company.'
1h takedown SLA via abuse@ alias (combine with M8 kill switch).
Submission video copy MUST be receipts-only (numbers and dates). No 'cannot ship' / 'failure' / 'incompetent' style adjectives.
